price_why: The creator gets a carousel they can shoot this afternoon, a Reel and Pin cut from the same footage, and a holiday plan worked back from real shipping dates. That's worth a small one-off fee, but most of the 6-week plan still needs hooks and formats settled before it can be made.
one_line: A well-researched brief that builds the next post (a saddle-stitch slant-fix carousel) slide by slide, then adds a 6-week Instagram/Pinterest plan tied to the holiday gift season.
strongest: The slant-fix carousel is complete: a problem beginners keep raising on the forums, a cover image and hook for slide 1, causes on slides 2–6, an honest note on slide 7, a before-and-after, a call to action, and a Reel and Pin cut from one shoot. It also serves buyers by showing how carefully the creator checks both faces of a seam.
weakest: The caption sketch gives the creator a line of made-up personal history ('the #1 question I got when I started') and a garbled hashtag line. Also, weeks 2–6 are mostly topic plus direction, with no settled hooks or formats.
